conditions: Oracle 19c E96448-09, chapter 10 package specification and body, including the conditions stated for when a body is required.
limitations: Public declaration does not imply permission to compile or invoke the item. The scope of grants and database schemas is separate.

triggers: Publisher revision, archived-byte drift, a documented qualifier, contrary source evidence or a controller change.

statement: The Oracle 19c reference describes a PL/SQL package specification as declaring public items. A package body is required when the specification declares cursors or subprograms, and optional otherwise. The body may declare private items.
